name: Basic E-commerce Queries
description: Essential query templates for e-commerce operations

templates.name: Get Products
templates.queryText: query GetProducts($limit: Int, $offset: Int) { nodes(tableId: "products", pagination: { limit: $limit, offset: $offset }) { nodes { id content title attributes { value attribute { identifier } } } totalCount hasNextPage } }

templates.name: Create Product
templates.queryText: mutation CreateProduct($input: CreateNodeInput!) { createNode(input: $input) { success data { id content title createdAt } errors { message } } }
